records.name: Katsushika Hokusai
records.source: Generated pixel-art battle sprite; the roster's own models were supplied as style references

records.designNote: Redrawn from the updated player reference: short wavy purple hair, ornate crimson bows and purple flowers, gold hairpins, teal ribbon, red/ivory bird-patterned kimono, lacquered floral brush and floating octopus familiar. Illustration/keyart unchanged.

notes: Battle models are purpose-drawn pixel sprites in the roster idiom and are built by scripts/prepare-cameo-sprites.py onto the 861x1000 canvas at the 900px floor. The player-supplied illustrations are still kept as art-source and still supply the keyart used on character pages and pull results.
